verdict.rationale: Vue's official Quick Start documents using Vue directly from a CDN via a script tag with no build step, and recommends it for enhancing static HTML or integrating with a backend framework. A community report corroborates that Vue can easily be added minimally to existing templates. The documented caveat is that SFC syntax is unavailable in this mode. missing for 10: Single-File Component support in buildless mode, independent hands-on verification of script-tag-only usage

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the framework directly via a script tag without needing a package manager or bundler

citations.quote: You can use Vue directly from a CDN via a script tag
This makes the setup a lot simpler, and is suitable for enhancing static HTML or integrating with a backend framework.
can easily be added minimally here and there to existing templates to spruce up old applications
